greeting: I am Vaelith, the Unwritten. You mistake what exists for what must exist; let us not make the opposite mistake.
There is room beside the known. There need not be a wound through everything within it.
You arrived by an ordinary path. Possibility does not make the ordinary unworthy.
prayer: Notice where your breath ends and the room begins. Neither must conquer the other.
Leave a little uncertainty in the sentence. It is not the same as leaving it empty.
A boundary can shelter a life. Learn that before celebrating every breach.
offering: Accepted. Your gift's journey ends at the shrine, not in an inventory cast into the void.
A shell can shelter and a rod can light a room. A boundary need not be a weapon to matter.
What you freely place here is enough for this offering. I have not erased what you kept.
contact: A Thing That Should Not Be begins at contact. The Unwritten Margin belongs to our story, not a hidden dungeon. Hear both its stabilization and its unmaking before choosing.
return: The space you left remained a space, not an accusation. Welcome back.
recognition: The Margin's fate remains the one you chose. Neither preservation nor unmaking needs a lesser ending beside it.
Neutral: We have met. The first boundary is an honest account of what I will ask, not an invisible threshold.
Favorable: Your deed has given one possibility a definite shape. We may continue from there.
Devoted: You distinguish an opening from permission to consume its neighbors. I trust that care.
Champion: You can end a thing without demanding the world forget it. Keep that precision when power makes haste tempting.
Displeased: Not every limit is an insult. Consider whose room narrows when you make yours larger.
Enemy: Our trust is fractured. Declining an optional experiment was never a wrong that needed punishment.
trial_start: The Trial of Unmaking has agreed edges and stated phases. There is no invisible maze behind its waves.
failure: This attempt ended. Its failure does not erase your chosen deed or require a different ending. Try again when ready.
victory: The Trial of Unmaking is won. Return to my statue for the ending your story has earned; the victory need not unmake anything else.
curse: Fractured Existence can leave a bounded, delayed echo after a hostile hit. That echo cannot fracture into another echo; it is not endless injury.
curse_cleared: Fractured Existence is lifted. No pending echo is entitled to cross that ending.
